headers.comment: Vite puts a content hash in every filename under /assets, so a changed file is a different URL and these can never go stale. Without this they were served max-age=0, must-revalidate, which cost a blocking conditional request for the entry bundle, the MapLibre worker and each lazy chunk on every single page load before any of it could run — the map cannot start until that round trip finishes.
index.html is the one file whose URL never changes, so it must be revalidated or a deploy would never reach anyone.
